content:
**Deathclaw Egg Omelette** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A Deathclaw Egg that has been cooked into an omelet over a fire. It gives a 30 minute HP regeneration effect while initially restoring a large amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Deathclaw Egg (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Deathclaw Egg | | Deathclaw Egg Omelette (1) | 

The spelling is that of British English. "Omelet" is the American English spelling. [1] 

Due to missing the keyword "TypeFoodHealing", this food is not buffed or affected by the Carnivore and Herbivore mutations, the Strange In Numbers perk and Magazines.
